title: World Bloom — Break Down the Wall — Episode10 Etching Our Name

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD continue their intensive training, set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND. But one day in the Street SEKAI, a new area suddenly appears: an unfamiliar plaza, in which stands a huge wall...

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, this should be where we're supposed to meet. Where is everyone...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An! You guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Welcome back!
How'd things on your end go?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I think we figured something out...!
Mind listening for a bit while I explain?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, this place is where we're supposed to interact with music from all different countries, so we can stand on top of the world?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting...
That didn't occur to me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither. I wouldn't have made that connection if it weren't for MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it sort of makes sense based on how this place's layout

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I agree with you there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means this place is bigger than we realize. I kinda like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm?
An, Miku, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I saw Aunt Nagi just earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Wh-What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't say for sure, but... I think I was able to see her because of what I was feeling.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She looked exactly the way she did when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So our feelings can be reflected in that much depth? SEKAI really is a mysterious place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, she was staring at that part of the wall over there with a kinda sad look on her face.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That part...?
Oh, you mean the weird blank spot?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Me and Miku talked about what we think that meant...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I think you just gave me the answer, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If this plaza's supposed to be filled with music from all around the world like you said...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then all this graffiti, flyers and stuff we see around here must also mean something.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They all have a meaning...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. That big blank spot in the middle...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think it's reserved for the team that's standing on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now I get it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Music from around the world all in one place...with the name of our event etched in here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And us standing on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Can't you at least stop for me in SEKAI?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Please! Just wait for me!
se_event_breakdown_2024_001

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She stopped...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Nagi departed this world before she could make her dream come true... Before she could etch her name into that wall.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And the people carrying the torch for her now are...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to succeed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to etch the name of our event in! Right in the center of the world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We gotta we gotta break down this wall first...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do it, you guys!!

rows.Speaker: Toya, An & Akito
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, that's settled...
So let's start practicing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
I feel like I can sing for hours on end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that's what I like to hear!
Then, let's sing until it's completely dark!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
What's that thing over by the edge of the plaza?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did a plant just sprout...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're right!
It's so adorably tiny!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did their feelings also produce this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If so, then what sorts of feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how it grows.

rows.Speaker: Movie
